Neon set a new Day-1 usage record on our paid APIs and @Antigravity tokens/day are ⬆️ 82% since Argon launched (only) 6 weeks ago.

It's been great to see the reception and thanks for all the model feedback including areas to improve - huge thanks to the teams across @GoogleDeepMind, Research, Infrastructure and serving teams, security efforts to make sure we are responsibly advancing the frontier and the product teams, more progress to come!
